data.title: Lead Product Designer - L6 (AEX)
data.description:
Lead Product Designer (L6)

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk.

We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group

  • Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area.

  • Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole.

  • Mentor and raise the bar of the designers around you - through critique, pairing, and modelling what excellent design looks like.

  • Drive AI thinking strategically - both in your own workflow (Claude Code, in-product changes, prototype testing) and in what we ship to users. You'll have a strong view on what makes a good AI feature in this domain vs a gimmicky one.

Why you should (and shouldn't) apply

You should apply if:

  • You've operated at senior IC level in a modern product org and you want broader scope to influence what gets built.

  • You're commercially fluent. You've made design trade-offs informed by how the product makes money, not just by user preference. You can name those trade-offs and defend them either way.

  • You define what success looks like before you ship, and you read the result against it after. Metrics, support data, customer feedback - you go and look.

  • You have strong, well-formed views on AI in product design and have put them into practice. You can articulate when AI is the right design solution and when it isn't.

  • You move at pace on strategic work, not just on features.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role. Lead expects materially more scope, autonomy, judgment, and ownership of outcomes.

  • You've never shipped design work where you defined a success measure upfront and checked the result afterwards. We need someone who already operates that way.

  • You've never had to make a commercial trade-off - design that's user-optimal but expensive to build, or design that doesn't move retention.

  • You'd struggle to explain how AI is changing what you ship, not just how you work. AI fluency is non-negotiable at this level.

  • You expect to be handed a brief. At L6 you identify what's worth doing and bring the case for it.

A bit about you

  • Experience: Roughly 8+ years of Product/UX Design experience, with a track record at senior IC level. SaaS or complex product experience is strongly preferred.

  • Outcomes, not artefacts: You can point to design work you've shipped where you wrote the success measure upfront and read the result after release. You know what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently.

  • Commercial fluency: You understand how the products you've worked on make money and you've made trade-offs informed by that.

  • AI: Comfortable using AI across your workflow and equally comfortable thinking strategically about AI in the products you design - what makes a good AI feature, what the failure modes are, what to build now vs later.

  • Craft: Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. You have views on interaction quality, hierarchy, motion, microcopy - and you can defend them.

  • Cross-functional: Comfortable as a peer at the table with product and engineering counterparts in your domain. Drive direction; don't wait for it.

  • Open to flex: This is predominantly an IC role, but we're not rigid about it. If you've line-managed before, or want to take on one or two direct reports alongside the IC work, we're open to that conversation.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

We don't have a fixed band published for this role yet - it'll be calibrated based on your experience and scope. Please apply and let's have the conversation.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

Interview Process

4 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc a design task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder/Head of Product.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

Our Legal team sits at the heart of that growth. This is a commercial role at its core: contracts and deals are the day job, with plenty of exposure to AI, data, regulatory, and corporate work alongside.

The Opportunity

This is a rare in-house role. A commercial counsel role with real breadth and even more ownership. Reporting to our Senior Legal Counsel, you'll own commercial contracts end to end, act as a trusted partner to the business, and lead cross-functional projects with real independence.

No two weeks look the same. One week you're leading a customer negotiation with our sales team. Next you're advising Product on an AI feature. You'll get variety, ownership, and the room to take work from first scoping to done.

If you want real ownership, thrive on variety, and want your work to matter across a fast-growing business, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Commercial Law

  • Commercial Contracts: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts independently — customer MSAs, public procurement frameworks, supplier T&Cs, professional services agreements, NDAs, and RFPs/bids.

  • GTM Partnership: Act as a key legal partner to the Go-To-Market sales team — provide proactive, commercially-minded guidance, join customer calls to lead negotiations, and ensure Legal scales with GTM to meet our growth objectives.

  • Risk Management: Conduct legal risk assessments and proactively identify and mitigate risks, exercising sound judgment on when to escalate and when to resolve independently.

  • Prioritisation & Delivery: Balance competing priorities across commercial deals, cross-functional projects, and business-as-usual legal work: knowing what to prioritise, using AI tools to work faster, and consistently meeting deadlines without close oversight.

Technology, AI and IP Support

  • Product & Platform: Advise Product/Tech teams on legal issues arising from product development, feature launches, and platform decisions.

  • AI Legal Landscape & Related Contracting: Review AI-related contractual provisions — IP ownership, liability, indemnities, and ethical use — and advise on how to contract safely around AI-driven products and services. Stay current on emerging AI regulation, market norms, and evolving legal standards; familiarity with the EU AI Act is advantageous, or a strong interest in developing expertise here.

  • IP: Support the management of Multiverse's IP portfolio, including trademark protection, licensing provisions, and IP considerations in new product features.


Project Management, Legal Operations & Cross-Functional Support

  • End-to-End Project Ownership: Own and drive cross-functional legal projects from scoping through to delivery: bringing the right people together, managing deadlines, and keeping everyone informed, with minimal supervision.

  • Legal Operations: Take ownership of internal legal resources (playbooks, clause libraries, templates) and help establish agile, tech-enabled processes that use AI to streamline the legal team's ways of working.

  • Team Development: Support other lawyers on their workstreams and provide hands-on guidance to our paralegal — building capability across the team.

  • Training & Enablement: Design and deliver training to the teams you support on key legal, commercial, and regulatory topics.

  • Privacy Partnership: Partner with the Privacy team on data protection requirements across products and commercial agreements.

  • Cross-Functional Support: Provide legal support to People, Privacy & Compliance, Finance, and Operations/Delivery/Learning — context-switching confidently across practice areas with a genuine interest in developing as a multi-specialist lawyer.

About You

Core Requirements

  • Qualification: Qualified solicitor in England & Wales. We're looking for crica 3 - 5 years post-qualification experience, but we care more about the depth and relevance of your experience than an exact PQE number.

  • Training: A strong private practice background, ideally trained at a leading national or international law firm. What matters most is the analytical rigour, sharp judgment and precise drafting discipline that top-tier training builds, wherever you build it.

  • In-House Experience: Ideally at least 1 year In-house experience, ideally at a SaaS/technology company (by permanent move or secondment). We need someone who has already made the transition from practice and operates as a business partner, not an external advisor.

  • Legal Tech & AI: Comfort leveraging legal technology and generative AI tools to streamline contract review, accelerate drafting, and optimize legal operations.

  • Commercial & Privacy Experience: Strong end-to-end B2B commercial contracts experience for both customers and suppliers, with solid GDPR and data privacy knowledge and experience working on data protection matters in a commercial context.

  • Project Management: Demonstrable ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously, working autonomously with strong attention to detail under time pressure.

  • Business vs. Risk Judgement: A solid understanding of when the business needs a quick, pragmatic reply versus when a matter requires a thorough deep dive.

Great to Have

  • Familiarity with or strong interest in the AI legal landscape including regulation and experience advising on legal issues related to AI products and services.

  • Experience with or exposure to M&A, corporate governance, or regulatory compliance.

Skills & Attributes

  • Autonomous Execution: You take ownership of delegated work and drive it to completion with confidence. You escalate when appropriate but don't need daily oversight.

  • Commercial Pragmatism: You identify the real risk, propose a practical solution, and help the business get to "yes" safely.

  • Stakeholder Credibility & Communication: Teams trust your advice because you understand their priorities, not because you wave legal risk at them. You communicate clearly and concisely to both legal and non-legal audiences, adapting your style to the stakeholder.

  • Team Player: No job is too big or too small. You contribute flexibly with a "can-do" approach.

  • Curiosity & Growth Mindset: You love solving problems and staying current on how AI and technology are transforming legal practice.

  • Mission-Driven: Genuinely motivated by Multiverse's mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

Benefits

data.title: Sr. Counsel - Regulatory
data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our Regulatory Legal team is the group responsible for maintaining and growing Kraken’s product offerings across the EU and UK and for advising the business on its day-to-day regulatory obligations. We’re a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice – partnering directly with Compliance, Product, and senior leadership to keep our licensed entities running smoothly and our regulators well served.

The Senior Counsel role is a remote role based in the UK or the EU, and will report into the EU/UK Regulatory Legal team. The role exists to own the significant volume of ongoing, business-as-usual regulatory work that currently falls to a small group of very senior lawyers – freeing them to focus on strategic licensing initiatives, complex transactions, and team leadership.

You will operate as a practical legal generalist with focus on:

  • Product advice covering Payward’s growing offerings in the EU and UK (Krak card, payments and staking, among other things)

  • Cryptoasset Regime Compliance (under MiCA/EU or in the UK) — advising on regulatory obligations for CASPs including supporting on the steady flow of regulatory queries, notifications and supervisory correspondence that keeps our licensed entities compliant and our regulatory relationships strong; and

  • Payments & e-money compliance — advising on regulatory obligations affecting our e-money and payment accounts and supporting related workstreams as they arise.

We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong regulatory fluency and a track record of independently owning BAU regulatory relationships (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector).

This is a fully remote role for a qualified lawyer in the UK or EU.

 

The opportunity

  • Provide legal support on cryptoasset, e-money and payment services regulatory requirements, including advising on account-access obligations and related operational compliance questions

  • Support the team’s active licensing applications and other in-flight EU/UK licensing or registration workstreams, including compiling application materials and coordinating with outside counsel

  • Provide regulatory support on corporate transactions and structural changes affecting EU/UK entities (e.g., change-of-control notifications, corporate client migrations)

  • Support the day-to-day relationship with regulators for our licensed entities

  • Translate complex regulatory frameworks (e.g., MiCA and the UK Cryptoasset Regime, CBI and FCA rulebooks, AML/CTF, DORA, outsourcing requirements, and e-money and payment services regulation) into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business

  • Foster a culture of clarity, favouring plain-English communication, measurable risk tradeoffs, and decision-ready recommendations

 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer (Solicitor/Barrister of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor/Barrister, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State)

  • 10+ years’ post-qualification experience (PQE) in financial services regulatory law gained at a regulated financial services institution (e.g., a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, or crypto services provider) or in a law firm/private practice supporting such clients, with demonstrated ability to independently own BAU regulatory workstreams

  • Direct experience supporting regulator engagement (e.g., with the CBI, FCA, or an equivalent EU competent authority), including notifications, information requests, and supervisory correspondence

  • Substantive experience advising on MiCA or the UK Cryptoasset Regime (i.e., FCA authorisation for regulated cryptoasset activities under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026) — experience with one regime is sufficient; both is not required

  • Substantive experience with e-money and payment services regulation in the EU or UK (experience in one jurisdiction is sufficient; both is not required), including account-access and open banking obligations

  • Experience in AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), including advising on related policies, controls, and regulatory expectations

  • Experience advising on outsourcing arrangements and operational resilience compliance (e.g., Digital Operational Resilience Act in the EU, or the FCA/PRA operational resilience regime in the UK)

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and clear recommendations

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and owning a broad, fast-moving BAU workload from day one

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with MiFID II and its application to investment services, including derivatives, equities, and emerging tokenised financial instruments

  • Experience supporting change-of-control notifications or other regulatory aspects of corporate transactions

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward’s and competitors’ products

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Full Time, Permanent

Role Purpose

This is a graduate engineering role for people who want to build a career in AI, data, and cloud. You will join Cloudscaler as an Associate Engineer, working on live problems from the start and developing towards SFIA Level 3 across core engineering skills within your first year. SFIA is the Skills Framework for the Information Age, the industry standard we use to measure engineering capability.

You will start alongside a graduate entry cohort and share the same in-person onboarding: our Welcome to Cloudscaler and Consulting Skills sessions. From day one you build your network and your consulting craft with peers going through the same experience. Your development is structured around real delivery, mentoring, and company-sponsored certifications.

How will you be supported

You will not be left to figure it out alone. You will have several lines of support working together.

  • A line manager who owns your day-to-day work and your development.

  • A dedicated mentor for pastoral support, separate from your line manager, so you always have someone in your corner.

  • An executive project sponsor (CCO, CRO, CPO, or COO) who oversees the scope and quality of your first project.

  • A cohort you onboard alongside, including our Level 6 apprentices, so you have peers from the start.

  • A funded route to certification for both AWS and Anthropic industry standard qualifications ensuring your career gets off on the right track.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build AI agents: design, prototype, and deploy agentic solutions using Python, large language models (LLMs), and AWS services, guided by experienced engineers.

  • Work with data: prepare and integrate data from internal systems, and evaluate rigorously whether your solutions actually work.

  • Ship to a standard: move solutions from prototype towards production, with proper testing, monitoring, and documentation.

  • Write like a professional: produce clear technical documentation, decision records, and status updates.

  • Work commercially: record your time accurately, work in Agile and Kanban rhythms, and take part in stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Use AI well: use Claude in your day-to-day work, and learn when to trust AI output and when to verify it. That judgement matters even more in regulated settings.

 

Required Experience

  • Degree: a strong degree (preferably 2:1 or above, or a Master’s) in Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related discipline.

  • Aptitude: solid programming ability, ideally in Python, and a real interest in AI, data, and cloud engineering.

  • Motivation: the drive to build a professional engineering career and the discipline to develop quickly on live work.

  • Behaviours: clear, honest communication, a collaborative attitude, and the willingness to ask for help and act on feedback.

  • Security clearance: you must be eligible for, and willing to undergo, Developed Vetting (DV). We run the checks when you join. DV carries UK nationality and residency requirements, so you will need to meet those to be considered.

What will make you stand out

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI agent frameworks, even from study or personal projects.

  • Exposure to Python, a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Docker, or Linux.

  • Evidence that you finish what you start: a project, a dissertation, or a side interest pursued to a good standard.

  • An interest in how AI is used responsibly in settings where you cannot take outputs at face value.

  • Discretionary security clearance bonus for those holding certain clearance

  • 25 days’ annual leave

  • 5 additional days per year towards training, certifications, or charity work

  • Option to buy additional annual leave up to 5 days per year

  • Public holidays opt-out scheme, the option to work on public holidays creating the flexibility to enjoy your time off when it suits you

  • Certifications and training expensed

Job title: Business Support Analyst

Department: Customer Success

Location: London (Hybrid — min. 3 days in office)

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom — a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat — but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

The Customer Success team is XYZ's frontline for ensuring customers realise the full value of The Atom — from onboarding and deployment through to renewal and expansion. Each CSM manages complex, high-stakes relationships with some of the world's largest hyperscaler and construction organisations, and their time is the most valuable resource in the function. Right now, too much of it is absorbed by administrative tasks — customer portal registrations, scheduling, reporting prep, and coordination work — instead of being on-site with customers and driving adoption.

This role exists to change that. The Business Support Analyst will sit within the Customer Success team in London and own the operational backbone that allows CSMs to focus on customers — handling portal and platform onboarding, meeting coordination, reporting administration, and the day-to-day operational load that would otherwise fall on the team.

This is a hands-on, present role. It requires understanding the rhythm of each CSM's portfolio well enough to anticipate what's needed before it's asked, and building the kind of trust that lets a CSM hand something off and not think about it again.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Own end-to-end registration and onboarding of XYZ into customer platforms, portals, and vendor management systems — including documentation gathering, compliance questionnaires, and portal data entry. Track status across all active accounts and flag blockers to the relevant CSM before they impact delivery.

• Maintain a live, accurate repository of standard customer-facing documentation (compliance certificates, insurance docs, company information packs) so re-submission for new accounts or renewals is fast and error-free.

• Schedule and coordinate customer meetings, QBRs, onboarding sessions, and internal syncs across CSM calendars — factoring in customer time zones and site availability. Manage logistics for on-site visits and prepare itineraries and briefing materials in advance.

• Support the preparation of customer-facing reports, health dashboards, and success review materials — pulling together data, formatting outputs, and ensuring CSMs walk into every customer touchpoint fully prepared.

• Act as first point of contact for CSM operational needs: CRM hygiene (Salesforce), document formatting, action log tracking, and coordination with Product, Engineering, and Finance on behalf of the team.

• Identify recurring operational bottlenecks across the CS function and propose process improvements — this role is expected to make the team more efficient over time, not just maintain the status quo.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

1. 2+ years in a business support, EA, operations, or administrative role — ideally supporting a Customer Success, Account Management, or client-facing team in a B2B environment.

2. Demonstrated experience managing customer or vendor portal registrations and compliance documentation.

3. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM (data entry, basic reporting, account and contact hygiene).

4. Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable corresponding directly with customer operations and procurement contacts on behalf of the CS team.

• High attention to detail and strong follow-through; this role is the operational safety net for a high-stakes customer function.

• Comfortable working across multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

• Familiarity with project coordination or reporting tools (e.g. Notion, Asana, Excel/Google Sheets) and document management.

• Experience supporting teams working with enterprise or hyperscaler customers — desirable.

• A proactive, anticipatory mindset — able to get ahead of a CSM's needs and build the kind of operational trust that frees them up to focus on customers.

BENEFITS

• 🚇 Office located within a 5-minute walk from Angel station

data.title: Director of Commercial Strategy UK/US (12-month contract)
data.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we've contributed over £10 million to this mission. Basically, we're really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

This is a 12-month, fixed-term role covering for one of our Commercial Strategy Directors while they're on leave — and it's a meaty one. You'll be the strategic engine behind our UK and US commercial strategy: turning category, market, retail and DTC data into sharp, real-world calls on portfolio, pricing and promotion. Think promotional discount modelling, retail pitches for new and existing retailers, and figuring out how to make our Amazon range work harder without undercutting our own DTC business. You'll report to our GM of Commercial Strategy + Insight, and work closely with regional retail, DTC, Supply Chain and Finance teams to keep the UK and US businesses growing profitably.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Modelled a few different discount depths for a new promotional mechanic, and made the call on what we'd recommend to leadership.
  • Pulled together a portfolio recommendation for a new retailer pitch — pack sizes, price points and all.
  • Dug into how our last DTC promotional campaign performed and worked out what we'd do differently next time.
  • Tweaked our Amazon pack and box sizes to maximise shipping efficiency. 
  • Fed insights into the UK and US annual planning process, working closely with the regional GMs.

Let's talk about you

You connect the dots faster than most

You can conduct detailed and thorough analysis, and then land on "so what does this mean for our strategy" — not just "here's the analysis." You're as comfortable with retail as you are with DTC, and you know how to build recommendations that can then be acted upon. 

You're just as comfortable in a spreadsheet as in a room full of GMs

This role spans portfolio, pricing and promotion across two markets — so you'll be building models one day and presenting trade-offs to senior stakeholders the next. You know how to manage up, bring people with competing priorities along, and hold your ground (with care) when the data tells an inconvenient story.

You back yourself in unfamiliar territory

This is a 12-month role picking up live, high-stakes projects from day one — there won't be months of ramp-up time. You're someone who gets comfortable with new systems and context quickly, is confident asking for help where needed, and isn't afraid to make a call while still learning the ropes.

data.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

You will be a senior practitioner and account leader for Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) across Jellyfish’s EMEA business and a portfolio of Tier 1 accounts, sitting within the Media team and reporting to the GEO Lead in EMEA. You will work closely with fellow GEO practitioners, sharing techniques and case studies.

You will bring methodology, codification and capability standards to life with clients, and translate the global GEO codex into EMEA market reality, including the fragmented search landscape across the region (Google, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini and market-specific search engines) for the CPG, retail and financial services concentration of the EMEA portfolio.

The majority of your time will be spent in front of clients, deepening GEO maturity across the accounts you own and delivering retained work to the standard our top clients demand. The remainder is spent on new business: bringing Share of Model™ diagnostics into pitches, carrying the GEO commercial narrative, and converting opportunity into retained revenue.

Responsibilities

  • 75% will be Client Work

    • Senior GEO partner to a portfolio of Jellyfish’s Tier 1 EMEA accounts, running the strategic conversation with CMOs, brand leads and search leaders.

    • Move clients from AI curiosity to AI maturity the headline KPI of the role. Measured on how many of the EMEA accounts in your portfolio move along that maturity curve, and how fast.

    • Drive adoption of advanced GEO practices inside the accounts you own, taking the latest techniques out of test and into committed retained work. Achieve measurable commercial and business success through best practices in SEO, GEO and Search.

    • Architect retained GEO engagements spanning content authority, technical site and structured data, entity reinforcement, AI training-signal optimisation, agentic readiness and ongoing measurement.

    • Own the GEO QBR narrative for major retained accounts. Lead annual planning conversations on GEO’s contribution to growth, citation lift and agentic readiness.

    • Diagnose AI-mediated search risk across the accounts you own: AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini, zero-click surfaces, and the fragmentation of traditional search signals across a widening set of AI-driven discovery engines.

    • Coach senior client-facing teams (account directors, strategy directors, retail media leads) on how to position GEO inside their day-to-day client conversations.

    • EMEA voice into global product Share of Model™ and Pencil Pro feature priorities, signal definitions, regional benchmarks and edge-case feedback fed back to the GEO Lead, EMEA and the Product team.

    • Surface regional learnings into the global codex experiments, case studies, automation hooks and edge cases that update the practice for every market, not just EMEA.

  • The other 25% will be dedicated to new business

    • Support GEO inside EMEA new business pitches bringing Share of Model™ diagnostics into pitches, shaping the GEO commercial narrative, and converting opportunity into retained revenue.

    • Contribute to the EMEA industry voice in service of new business and category leadership: IAB Europe, SMX London, DMEXCO, BrightonSEO, AI marketing summits, and the strategic PR moments that shape how Jellyfish is perceived in the region.

    • Secure EMEA platform alpha and beta access through direct relationships with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft and Amazon AGI / Rufus teams, converting access into client advantage faster than the market can reach for it.

Qualifications

  • You are an experienced senior practitioner, most likely with over 6 years in SEO, search strategy or digital media, including direct work in AI-influenced search environments and at least one major EMEA enterprise account.

  • You translate model behaviour and citation analysis into business consequences without sliding into jargon. You are credible with senior marketing stakeholders.

  • You understand how knowledge graphs, structured data, embeddings, retrieval systems and training signals actually work, and you can spot weak strategies.

  • You have a track record of converting AI capability into retained revenue.

  • You understand the fragmented, multi-market EMEA search landscape, the regulatory backdrop, and how AI-mediated discovery is playing out differently across CPG, retail, financial services and tech.

  • You share what you learn, raise the bar for the practitioners around you, and make it easy for colleagues across accounts to get GEO right.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
data.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

You can expect to:

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

What we're looking for

  • At least five (5) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.

  • Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

Our culture

At Synthesia we're passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

The hiring process:

  • 30 min call with our Technical Recruiter

  • 45 min call with the Head of Website about your past projects

  • 75 min practical exercise with one of our engineers. We hand you a real Figma section spec and work through how you'd model and build it. Collaborative, not Leetcode.

  • 60 min call with leadership, focused on examples of collaboration, growth, and the details of your future team.

Other important info:

  • Our preference is for this role to be based either in-office or remote in London, UK. We can also accommodate remote workers elsewhere in Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks.

  • This is full-time employment only, usually through OysterHR. No contractors possible.

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW

The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow.

We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation.

You’ll ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver against their objectives and provide an excellent experience for our clients and internal teams. You’ll proactively solve delivery challenges, identify opportunities to maximise revenue and use data to turn campaign performance into valuable insights.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while helping Campaign Operations become smarter, more efficient and increasingly scalable.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AEM Backend Developer - Senior based in United Kingdom.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced backend developer to build and enhance enterprise-grade digital experiences using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of scalable web content management solutions that support large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment, you will leverage modern Java technologies and AEM best practices to deliver high-quality solutions. You will partner with cross-functional teams to create reliable, maintainable, and high-performing applications while contributing to continuous improvement and technical excellence. This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building impactful digital products.


Accountabilities:

As a Senior AEM Backend Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust AEM-based solutions while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver scalable digital experiences.

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend solutions using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Java technologies.
  • Build and extend AEM components, services, integrations, and administrative functionality to meet business requirements.
  • Develop and support Web Content Management (WCM) components and enterprise applications.
  • Implement and maintain integrations using REST APIs and related web technologies.
  • Work with AEM frameworks including JCR, Apache Sling, Apache Felix, and OSGi to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Manage project dependencies and builds using Maven and AEM Maven archetypes.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers and other technical teams to deliver seamless end-to-end digital experiences.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues, optimize application performance, and ensure code quality through best development practices.
  • Contribute to architecture discussions, technical documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced AEM backend developer with strong Java expertise, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within distributed teams.

    • Professional software development experience with a strong focus on Java.
    • Solid hands-on experience working with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
    • Strong understanding of AEM architecture and core building blocks.
    • Experience extending AEM functionality and working with administrative features.
    • Expertise in developing WCM components, custom integrations, and enterprise applications.
    • Practical knowledge of JCR, Apache Sling, Apache Felix, OSGi, REST, JavaScript, and JSON.
    • Experience using Maven and familiarity with AEM Maven archetypes.
    • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AJAX.
    • Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher English communication skills.
    • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and collaborative mindset.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work opportunity within United Kingdom.
      • Competitive salary based on skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
      • Comprehensive employee benefits package.
      • Opportunity to work on innovative digital transformation projects with global clients.
      • Collaborative, diverse, and inclusive work environment.
      • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
      • Exposure to modern AI-driven technologies and enterprise-scale digital platforms.

data.title: Maintenance Manager UK (m/f/x)
data.description:
Your Mission

As Maintenance Manager UK, you will be responsible for the operational performance, maintenance delivery, service reliability, and asset availability of ubitricitys EV charging infrastructure across the United Kingdom.
You will lead the management of maintenance contractors, oversee Run & Maintain contracts, drive network availability, and ensure maintenance activities are delivered in line with contractual obligations and service level agreements. Working closely with local authorities, service providers, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and the continued growth of the UK's EV charging network.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own and manage maintenance operations across the UK EV charging network, ensuring high standards of safety, service delivery, and operational performance.
  • Oversee planned, preventative, and reactive maintenance activities, ensuring all work is completed in accordance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and agreed service levels.
  • Drive charger availability and network uptime through effective maintenance planning, performance monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead investigations into recurring faults and service issues, implementing corrective actions to improve asset reliability and customer experience.
  • Manage maintenance contractors, suppliers, and service providers, holding them accountable for performance against agreed KPIs, SLAs, and contractual requirements through regular governance and performance reviews.
  • Own the performance and compliance of Run & Maintain contracts, identifying risks, opportunities, and service improvements to support business objectives.
  • Act as the primary operational contact for local authorities, contractors, service providers, and key stakeholders, building and maintaining strong working relationships.
  • Analyse maintenance and operational data to identify trends, improve service performance, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Manage maintenance-related budgets, contractor expenditure, purchase orders, and invoice approvals, ensuring effective financial control and value for money.
  • Manage inventory levels, spare parts, and stock control processes, ensuring critical components are available to support maintenance activities, minimise downtime, and support network growth.
  • Collaborate with Customer Service, Asset Management, Delivery, Finance, Product, and other internal teams to resolve operational issues and support the successful delivery of business objectives.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement by identifying and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, customer satisfaction, network reliability, and maintenance efficiency.

Your profile

Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years' experience in maintenance management, service delivery, asset management, infrastructure operations, utilities, transport, telecommunications, EV charging, or a similar operational environment.
  • Proven experience managing maintenance contractors, suppliers, and service providers, with responsibility for performance, compliance, and delivery against contractual KPIs and SLAs.
  • Strong knowledge of maintenance operations, incident management, contract management, and operational service delivery within an asset-intensive environment.
  • Experience managing maintenance budgets, supplier expenditure, invoice approvals, procurement activities, and cost control.
  • Demonstrated experience managing spare parts, inventory, stock control processes, and asset lifecycle activities to support operational performance.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, develop performance insights, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills, with experience working across internal teams, suppliers, contractors, local authorities, and external partners.
  • Experience using maintenance management, asset management, ticketing, or field service management systems, alongside advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.

Qualifications

  • Previous administrative, operations, or contract coordination experience required.
  • Educated to Bachelors, BTEC, or Engineering equivalent qualification preferred.
  • Experience within the EV charging, renewable energy, utilities, Construction, infrastructure, or field service sectors is advantageous but not essential.

Our Offer

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in the E-Mobility transition by scaling a well-established and uniquely placed business in the sector. ubitricity offer the opportunity to work in an agile, forward-thinking start-up backed by leading global energy and automotive companies.

Benefits of working at ubitricity

  • 25 holiday days (plus public holidays)
  • Hybrid Working (min. 2 days in the office NW5)
  • Opportunities for trips to Berlin head office
  • A choice of: Healthcare Insurance with Comprehensive level of cover, Employer Pension Monthly top up
  • Free coffee and healthy snacks in office
  • Social company events Statement on diversity
    We take pride in being a diverse organisation with a strong diversity and inclusion culture. We believe that everyone is different, and that difference brings value. Inclusion and inclusive behaviours are at the heart of effective collaboration, be it with team members, colleagues in other parts of our company, or with our customers. Every voice is heard.

Manager Kooperationen & Social Impact: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit · Bremen
data.description:
Menschen verbinden. Zukunft gestalten.

Wir suchen keinen klassischen CSR-Manager. Keinen Verwalter von Projekten, keinen Berichtsschreiber, keinen reinen Terminkoordinator.

Wir suchen einen Menschen, der andere Menschen begeistert. Einen Netzwerker, Gestalter, Möglichmacher – jemanden, der Türen öffnet, Vertrauen schafft und aus Kontakten echte Partnerschaften macht.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Neue Partnerschaften mit Unternehmen, Schulen, Vereinen, Stiftungen und Institutionen aufbauen
  • Bestehende Kooperationen langfristig und persönlich pflegen
  • Kundenevents, Genussabende, Netzwerkveranstaltungen und Benefizformate organisieren
  • Neue Konzepte zur Förderung von Kindern und Jugendlichen entwickeln
  • Sponsoren, Förderer und neue Kooperationspartner gewinnen
  • Den Bremer Gewürzhandel und die Genusshelfer-Initiative nach außen repräsentieren
  • Chancen für gemeinsame Projekte erkennen und daraus nachhaltige Partnerschaften entwickeln
  • Eng mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Geschäftsführung zusammenarbeiten
  • Gute Geschichten sichtbar machen und Menschen damit inspirieren
  • Momente aus Kooperationen und Events festhalten (Fotos, Video-Rohmaterial) und damit unsere Social-Media-Kanäle mit Content versorgen

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen:

Dein Lebenslauf ist zweitrangig – entscheidend ist deine Persönlichkeit. Vielleicht kommst du aus Marketing, Vertrieb, Eventmanagement, Fundraising, Projektmanagement, Hotellerie, Tourismus, Kommunikation oder Vereinsarbeit. Vielleicht auch aus einem ganz anderen Bereich.

Du passt zu uns, wenn du...

  • offen, herzlich und sicher auf Menschen zugehst
  • andere ehrlich begeistern und für Ideen gewinnen kannst
  • Beziehungen mit Vertrauen und Verbindlichkeit aufbaust
  • unternehmerisch denkst und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge verstehst
  • Chancen erkennst und eigenständig handelst
  • Verantwortung übernimmst und Dinge zuverlässig umsetzt
  • Freude an Veranstaltungen, Netzwerken und neuen Begegnungen hast
  • organisiert arbeitest, ohne dich in Verwaltung zu verlieren
  • gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen möchtest
  • auch mal selbst zur Kamera greifst, um Momente einzufangen

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Vertrauen und Gestaltungsspielraum statt Stelle von der Stange
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Motivierte Kolleg:innen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
  • Eine Aufgabe, bei der du täglich siehst, wie aus Ideen echte Wirkung entsteht

Unsere Vision:

Wir möchten mehr sein als ein erfolgreiches Handelsunternehmen. Wir möchten Vorreiter unserer Branche sein und zeigen, wie sich Genuss, Wirtschaftlichkeit und gesellschaftliche Verantwortung glaubwürdig verbinden lassen – nicht mit einmaligen Aktionen, sondern dauerhaft.

Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst und Lust hast, mit uns etwas Außergewöhnliches aufzubauen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

data.title: Standortleiter Heidelberg (m/w/d)
data.description:
Bei PANGEA dreht sich alles um smarte und nachhaltige Gebäudelösungen. Ob Wärmepumpe oder energetische Gesamtsanierung: Wir denken ganzheitlich und setzen unsere Projekte selbst um – mit eigenen Handwerksteams, klaren Prozessen und viel Leidenschaft.

Wir begleiten unsere Kund von der ersten Beratung über die Planung bis zur fertigen Umsetzung. Alles aus einer Hand.

Als Standortleiter bist du der unternehmerische Gesamtverantwortliche für deinen PANGEA-Standort. Du sorgst dafür, dass Vertrieb, Operations, Finanzen und HR effizient zusammenarbeiten und der Standort wirtschaftlich erfolgreich wächst.

Dabei führst du mit Klarheit, Vertrauen und Transparenz, entwickelst dein Team weiter und setzt unsere Strategie und Kultur vor Ort um.

Wenn du unternehmerisch denkst, Verantwortung übernehmen willst und gleichzeitig nah am operativen Geschäft bleiben möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig als Standortleiter (m/w/d).

Aufgaben

  • Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für deinen Standort – wirtschaftlich, personell und operativ
  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Team aus Handwerk, Projektleitung, Operations und Account Management
  • Du steuerst Umsatz, Kosten, EBIT und weitere relevante KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab
  • Du stellst eine hochwertige, termingerechte Projektabwicklung und ein starkes Kundenerlebnis sicher
  • Du entwickelst deinen Standort und die Region weiter und treibst perspektivisch den Aufbau weiterer Standorte voran.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit und kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, handelst eigenverantwortlich und triffst Entscheidungen
  • Du bist strukturiert, organisationsstark und behältst auch bei vielen Themen den Überblick
  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und idealerweise einen Bezug zu Handwerk, Bau oder technischen Dienstleistungen mit
  • Du verstehst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und verbindest Kundenorientierung mit Qualität und Profitabilität.

Benefits

  • Du bekommst echte unternehmerische Verantwortung und großen Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Geschäftsführung und den zentralen PANGEA-Teams zusammen
  • Du kannst einen Standort nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv aufbauen und weiterentwickeln
  • Du erhältst eine attraktive Vergütung sowie 30 Tage Urlaub und Benefits wie Hansefit, BusinessBike und VL
  • Du hast eine klare Perspektive auf zusätzliche Verantwortung, weitere Standorte und eine mögliche Geschäftsführungsrolle

data.title: Interviewer/innen für Telefon-Befragungen - Minijob im Homeoffice
data.description:
Wir bieten Dir einen Minijob in der Telefonmarktforschung an, den Du deutschlandweit aus dem Homeoffice machen kannst. Wenn Du 603 Euro pro Monat von zuhause dazu verdienen willst, kommunikativ bist und sehr gut Deutsch sprichst, dann suchen wir genau Dich als Interviewer oder Interviewerin. Die Tätigkeit als Interviewer ist gut für Quereinsteiger geeignet.

Aufgaben

Du befragst Menschen am Telefon für seriöse deutschlandweite Studien, u.a. zu den Themen Radiohören, Lebensqualität, Nachhaltigkeit, Reise- und Urlaubsverhalten und gesunde Ernährung.

Wenn Du gerne telefonierst, Menschen am Telefon anhand eines vorgegebenen Fragebogens befragen willst und über gute Deutschkenntnisse verfügst, kannst Du bei uns als Telefon-Interviewer:in in der Markt- und Sozialforschung starten.

Was wir machen

Durch unsere telefonischen Umfragen geben wir Meinungen eine Stimme und sorgen dafür, dass diese in die Entwicklung von Produkten oder Dienstleistungen und in öffentliche Entscheidungen einfließen können. Markt- und Meinungsforschung will Meinungen erfragen – aber nichts verkaufen und macht auch keine Werbung. Es geht um wissenschaftliche Studien.

Qualifikation

Gute Telefon-InterviewerInnen bringen folgende wichtige Eigenschaften mit:

  • Spaß am Telefonieren und beim Umgang mit Menschen
  • Eine freundliche und sympathische Telefonstimme
  • Eine deutliche und artikulierte Aussprache
  • Ein sicheres Auftreten am Telefon
  • Flexibilität, Teamgeist, Zuverlässigkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft
  • Eine sorgfältige und genaue Arbeitsweise
  • Mindestens 18 Jahre
  • Gute PC-Kenntnisse
  • Du solltest in Deutschland leben.

Da Du diese Aufgabe im Rahmen eines Minijobs ausführst, werden ein Aufenthaltstitel (nur bei Nicht-EU Bürgern) und keine weitere Nebenbeschäftigung vorausgesetzt.

Benefits

Das bieten wir:

  • verlässlicher Minijob als Interviewer:in
  • max. 603 Euro pro Monat
  • 13,90 Euro pro Stunde
  • attraktives, sicheres Nebeneinkommen
  • flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • aktuelle Forschungsthemen
  • 2-mal bis 3-mal pro Woche arbeiten
  • regelmäßige Coachings und Schulungen
  • angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem netten Team
  • gut für Quereinsteiger geeignet
  • Arbeiten im Telefonstudio oder zu 100% im Home Office

Super flexible Arbeitszeiten:

Die Tätigkeit ist in unserem Telefonstudio oder bundesweit im Homeoffice zu folgenden Zeiten möglich:

  • Mo-Fr zwischen 15:45-20:45 Uhr
  • Sa-So zwischen 10:15-15:15 Uhr

Du kannst Deine Arbeitszeiten innerhalb der o.g. Zeiträume wählen. Wünschenswert sind 8-9 Arbeitsstunden pro Woche. Ein Arbeitseinsatz sollte mind. 3 Stunden andauern.

Fundierte Schulungen und Trainings:

Schon im Bewerbungsprozess erhältst Du weitere Informationen, Trainings und praktische Anwendungsmöglichkeiten um in der professionellen Telefonie fit zu werden. In der späteren Arbeitspraxis geben Dir unsere Supervisor*innen Feedback zu Deinen Talenten in der Telefonarbeit und im Umgang mit Gesprächspartnern.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich und Deine Talente in der Telefonarbeit. Solltest Du vor der Bewerbung noch Fragen haben, wende Dich bitte an Frau Susanne Richter unter 06128-747-631.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
At 5Plus (part of Pentadoc Group), we build production-grade AI systems that solve real operational problems for our customers.

As a Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d), you will take technical responsibility for customer-facing AI solutions — from early design decisions to production deployment and operation. You will design, build, and operate AI applications ranging from LLM-powered workflows (e.g., intelligent document processing, RAG systems) to agentic AI systems that are actively used in customer environments.

German language skills at C1 level or above are essential for this role.

You’ll work closely with customers and internal engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into reliable, scalable systems and guide AI-driven product development within customer projects. This role is hybrid, with predominantly remote work and occasional on-site presence at customer locations across Germany and our office in Würzburg, Bavaria.

Your profile

  • Several years (3–6) of hands-on experience building and operating AI/ML systems in real-world projects.
  • At least one practical implementation of agentic AI systems, beyond simple chains or demos, ideally in a production or near-production context.
  • **Strong Python expertise (**app. 5 years) and experience with modern AI/LLM tooling; framework-agnostic mindset.
  • Proven experience with LLM-based systems (e.g., RAG, embeddings, tool usage) and an understanding of trade-offs between quality, cost, latency, and complexity.
  • Ability to work independently in customer-facing environments, taking ownership of technical decisions under uncertainty.
  • Professional communication skills in customer contexts.
  • Residence in Germany.

Bonus points to score

  • Deeper experience with agentic architectures (planning, memory, multi-agent coordination).
  • Experience deploying and operating AI services in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, etc.).
  • Contributions to open-source projects, technical writing, or applied research.

Your daily business

  • Design and ship end-to-end AI systems, from prototype to production.
  • Build LLM-powered applications (incl. RAG, tool usage, validations) with a focus on reliability and cost-efficiency.

  • Define evaluation strategies (offline + online), including metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring.

data.title: Senior Paid Social Manager – Meta & TikTok, Perspektive Paid Social Lead (m/w/d) · Remote
data.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Mittwochmorgen. Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark.

Du erhöhst direkt die Budgets. Anschließend briefst du Anna, unsere Creative Strategistin, auf die Iteration der Best Performer.

Anna baut mit Alex, Mona und Tobi aus dem Creative Team ein neues Set. UGC, Founder Ads und mehrere Statics. Wenige Tage später gehen sie live.

Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance und die nächsten Schritte. Dazu deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Produktlaunch. Rabatte allein reichen dir nicht. Jede Bestellung muss einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag tragen.

Danach briefst du dein Team. Jeder Schritt der Kampagne ist klar verteilt. Am Launchtag knackst du für den Kunden 50.000 € Ad Spend an einem Tag, profitabel.

Genau das ist dein Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Wir denken Paid Social anders

Dass das Creative über die Performance entscheidet, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Das ist Standard. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel mit. Denn ein starker ROAS entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads. Er entsteht aus dem Angebot dahinter:

  • Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht.

  • Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Creative verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter.

  • Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output.

Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Werbekonten. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Wachstum deiner Kunden über Social Ads und entwickelst eigenständig die richtige Strategie.

Denn wir arbeiten nicht mit Kunden zusammen, um Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir arbeiten mit ihnen, um sie zum Wachsen zu bringen.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung

  • Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend.

  • Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit Anna und dem Creative Team. UGC, Founder Ads und Statics entstehen aus Testdaten, nicht aus Bauchgefühl.

  • Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien. Unser Team setzt sie um und arbeitet sie im Detail aus.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohen Ad-Spend-Leveln nicht lange.

  • Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst auf Entscheiderebene, nicht nur zum Kanal

  • Du baust den Social Ads Bereich weiter aus, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE einmal. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid Social Team übernehmen will und sich perspektivisch als Paid Social Lead entwickelt.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei

  • Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets

  • Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, Admetrics oder Tracify

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Ohne diese Zahlen lässt sich profitabel nicht skalieren

  • Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst Projekte entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts

  • Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, und nicht nur, dass es verkauft

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung. Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, auch weil wir 100 % remote arbeiten

  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring von Junioren

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du keine E-Commerce-Erfahrung mitbringst. Wir suchen jemanden, der Accounts auf exzellentem Niveau steuert. Fachlich challengen wir dich gern. Das E-Commerce-Know-how solltest du jedoch schon mitbringen.

Der Rahmen

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in die EVOLVE-Methodik und unsere Prozesse. Du übernimmst erste Accounts gemeinsam mit dem Team.

Mittelfristig. Volle Verantwortung für mehrere High-Budget-Accounts. Du steuerst das Paid-Social-Team fachlich und onboardest ein weiteres Teammitglied.

Langfristig. Du führst als Paid Social Lead den gesamten Social Ads Bereich, fachlich und disziplinarisch, bis zu zehn Personen.

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.
